Package com.filmssql.domain.entity

package com.filmssql.domain.entity
JPA entities representing the domain model (movies, actors, awards, references).
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Actor
    Actor participating in movies; linked one-to-one with ActorInfo.
    ActorInfo
    Detailed biographical info for an actor, sharing primary key with Actor.
    ActorMovie
    Join entity linking actors to movies with the played role.
    Country
    Country reference used for movie releases and production metadata.
    Genre
    Movie genre reference (e.g., Drama, Comedy).
    Language
    Language reference used in movie metadata.
    Movie
    Movie aggregate with poster, cast, crew, genres, studios, countries, languages and releases.
    MovieRolePerson
    Join entity mapping crew members (person) to a movie with a specific role.
    OscarAward
    Oscar award entry, optionally linked to an actor or movie.
    Person
    Generic person entity used for crew credits.
    Poster
    Poster asset linked one-to-one with a movie.
    ReleaseMovie
    Release information for a movie, including country, date and type.
    ReviewMovie
    Critic review associated with a movie.
    Role
    Role reference (e.g., Director, Writer) used by crew associations.
    Studio
    Studio/production company reference.
    Theme
    Thematic tag associated with a movie.
